profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Atlassian
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with a strong interest in creative software and web applications. I've been involved in the creation of professional software and am always improving my skills in development. Proficient with JavaScript, Node.js, React.js, Redux, Angular, and SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and documented features for the web application
• Collaborated with UX, Product and Quality teams to deliver products
• Migrated outdated Angular 1/jQuery components to Angular 9+/ES6 
• Debugged and Triaged production issues
• Created new components for UI component library and enhanced existing components

positions.title: Quality Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on site at Adobe in San Jose
• Wrote automation scripts with Appium in Java and Javascript
• Tested software on iOS and UWP
• Delivered user stories with Pivotal Tracker
• Submitted bug reports, verified fixes and created test cases in Jira

positions.title: Web Application Development Intern
positions.description:
• Coded module that uploads json file data into a mySQL server for company web application
• Created HTML forms with proprietary tools

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
• Troubleshoot/Fixed electronic devices
• Solved network connectivity issues and computer virus problems
• Worked with online and paper ticketing system

positions.title: LEGO Robotics Instructor
positions.description: • Taught elementary school students simple engineering concepts such as programming and design with LEGO Robotics kits and software

projects.title: Jot Down
projects.description: A note taking app that syncs data to the cloud. Built with React/Redux for its front end, Node/Express as its backend, and utilizes Postgres to store data

projects.title: Signal
projects.description: In the search for intelligent life in the universe you must quickly follow the incoming signals being sent out towards you by matching their patterns and creating a path to the planet it originates from.
